info.name: Rosetta Lab 05 - Authentication and Authorization (RBAC)
info.description: Automated Postman Test Suite for Lab 05 covering User Registration, Input Validation, Duplicate Email Check, Bcrypt Password Hashing, JWT Login, Authentication Middleware, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

exec: const randomId = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
pm.environment.set('testUserEmail', 'student_' + randomId + '@rosetta.local');
pm.environment.set('testUsername', 'student_' + randomId);
pm.test('01.1 - Status code is 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('01.2 - Returns JWT token', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('01.3 - User object contains role User and email', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.role).to.eql('User'); pm.expect(d.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('testUserEmail')); });
pm.test('01.4 - Password is not leaked in response', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.password).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(d.password).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('02.1 - Status code is 409 Conflict', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('02.2 - Error indicates duplicate email', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.include('already registered'); });
pm.test('03.1 - Status code is 400 Bad Request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('03.2 - Error indicates password requirement', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.include('at least 6 characters'); });

item.name: 04. User Login (Verify Email & Password -> Extract Token)

exec: pm.test('04.1 - Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('04.2 - Returns valid JWT token', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.environment.set('userToken', d.token); });

pm.test('04.3 - User object is sanitized', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('testUserEmail')); pm.expect(d.user.password).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('05.1 - Status code is 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('05.2 - Error message indicates invalid credentials', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.error).to.include('Invalid'); });
pm.test('06.1 - Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('06.2 - User role is Admin', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.user.role).to.eql('Admin'); pm.environment.set('adminToken', d.token); });

item.name: 07. Access Protected Endpoint Without Token (Missing Token)

exec: pm.test('07.1 - Status code is 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('07.2 - Error indicates missing token', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.message).to.include('Token missing'); });

item.name: 08. Access Protected Endpoint With Invalid Token

exec: pm.test('08.1 - Status code is 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('08.2 - Error indicates invalid or expired token', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.message).to.include('Invalid or expired token'); });

item.name: 09. Access Protected Endpoint With Valid Token (User Role)

exec: pm.test('09.1 - Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('09.2 - Returns array of cards', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: 10. Create New Card With Valid Token

exec: pm.test('10.1 - Status code is 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('10.2 - Returns created card object and id', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('createdCardId', d.id); });

item.name: 11. RBAC Test: Regular User Attempting Delete (Forbidden 403)

exec: pm.test('11.1 - Status code is 403 Forbidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('11.2 - Error indicates Admin role required', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.message).to.include('Admin'); });

item.name: 12. RBAC Test: Admin User Attempting Delete (Allowed 200)

exec: pm.test('12.1 - Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('12.2 - Success confirmation returned', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.success).to.be.true; });
pm.test('13.1 - Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('13.2 - Returns current user details without password', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('testUserEmail')); pm.expect(d.password).to.be.undefined; });
